whenToUse: Values within a fixed range, such as a price cap, brightness, or volume.
People change a value and check the result right away.
whenNotToUse: An exact value must be entered (use a number input).
The range is so wide that one step is too large.
Setting a minimum and a maximum together (use a range slider).

alternatives.name: Range Slider
alternatives.reason: Setting a minimum and a maximum together.

accessibility: It's a native range input, so the arrows, Page Up/Down, Home/End, and touch all work.
aria-valuetext reads the value with its unit, such as "35,000 won".
The current value also shows on screen in an output element.
The handle is enlarged to 20px so it's easy to grab with a finger.
